name: pyforge-lab-server
description: Docker-backed lab session orchestrator for PyForge

scripts.build:images: TAG=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && docker build -t pyforge-lab:1 -t pyforge-lab:$TAG -f images/lab.Dockerfile images/ && docker build -t pyforge-tgt-www:1 -t pyforge-tgt-www:$TAG -f images/targets/www.Dockerfile images/targets/ && echo "Built tag: $TAG"
